annotations.title: Recent utility digs near an address

description: Lists utility excavation permits on the blocks around one street address in New York City, Washington, DC, San Francisco, Los Angeles, San Diego, Seattle, Denver, Chicago, and Dallas, newest first, at most 25 with the total found: the utility, the permit holder, what the work was, the issue date (or, where a city publishes none, the start date) and work window, whether digging is permitted today or scheduled to start later, the street and its distance, and, for a job permitted again and again, how many permits it has run to since when. Use it to see who holds permits on a block, what work is open now or scheduled, which jobs drag on, and how often the street gets opened, when planning or coordinating work there. Narrow with radius_m, since_year, utility or permitted_today. Permits that don't cut the street (opening a manhole, storing material) are left out. Answers are public-records evidence with a records-as-of date and end with the city's 811 notice.

address.description: A street address with house number, in New York City, Washington, DC, San Francisco, Los Angeles, San Diego, Seattle, Denver, Chicago, or Dallas. Include the city, e.g. "200 N Spring St, Los Angeles" or "33 Union Square West, Manhattan".

city.description: Which city the address is in, to search only that city and rule out a lookalike address elsewhere. One of "nyc" for New York City, "dc" for Washington, DC, "sf" for San Francisco, "la" for Los Angeles, "sd" for San Diego, "sea" for Seattle, "den" for Denver, "chi" for Chicago, "dal" for Dallas. The full name or a common short form works too, in any case: "Los Angeles", "NYC", "Brooklyn", "D.C.".

permitted_today.description: true for only the permits whose work window includes today.

radius_m.description: How far around the address to look, in meters. Default 150, at most 400.

since_year.description: Only permits issued in this year or later. Where a city publishes no issue date (Los Angeles, Denver), the year the work starts counts.

utility.description: Only this kind of work: "electric" (electric), "gas" (gas), "telecom" (telecom), "water" (water), "sewer" (sewer), "steam" (steam), "capital" (city rebuild).

name: recent_digs

address.description: The address as the city geocoder found it

credits.description: The credit the city's publishers ask for, and OpenStreetMap's; quote it with the records

distanceM.description: Meters from the address to the nearest block the permit is filed on

issued.description: The day the city issued the permit; null where the city publishes no issue date (Los Angeles, Denver), so go by workStart

nth.description: This permit's place in the job, 1 for the first

permits.description: Permits filed for this one job

renewals.description: Permits the city itself filed as a renewal or extension (New York only); null where the city does not say

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the job's first work start

through.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the job's last work end

workOrder.description: The utility's work order, where the permit names one

job.description: Set when this permit is one of 3 or more for the same job, re-permitted as the work dragged on (same holder and work order, or same holder, work and street, each following closely)

found.description: The same as total; kept for clients written against 1.0

incomplete.description: Some map data failed to load; the answer may miss records

matchDiffers.description: Whether the matched address reads differently from the one asked for

matchedAddress.description: The address the answer is for; the same as address, kept beside requestedAddress

permittedToday.description: Whether only permits open today were asked for

recordsAsOf.description: When the records were last built, ISO 8601

requestedAddress.description: The address as it was asked for

shown.description: Digs listed here: total, or the cap when there are more

total.description: Digs on record that match, before the cap

utility.description: The utility asked for, or null for all

title: Recent utility digs near an address
